about: The whole BO3 arsenal. One row per gun. Its stats, model, textures and sounds are NOT here: they are read from the player's own BO3 copy at runtime (bo3_sources), keyed by bo3_asset. A gun whose asset is missing from the player's copy (DLC not owned) is hidden, never faked. bo3_upgraded_asset 'auto' = '<bo3_asset>_upgraded' (Pack-a-Punch).

mode.desc: Which BO3 mode's files carry it

zones.desc: BO3 zone (fastfile) names that contain it

dlc.desc: Content it comes with in BO3

mystery_box.desc: Can roll from the Mystery Box

verified.desc: Asset name, zone and content confirmed in the player's BO3 files
